reason: An unofficial DeepSeek Harness web theme plugin that provides two selectable visual themes, bundled artwork, appearance controls, and decorative status-state visuals.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面提供两套可切换的轴伊 Joi 主题、配套视觉素材和外观设置。
summaries.en: Provides two selectable Joi-themed visual styles for the DeepSeek Harness web interface, with bundled artwork and appearance controls.

capabilities: Customizes the DeepSeek Harness web interface appearance
Provides selectable visual themes and light/dark presentation variants
Displays bundled character and decorative image assets
Adds visual status indicators for interface states
